name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT 
    ao.item AS "Add-on Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
    COUNT(ao.name) AS "Sold Count:Int:150"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` ao
JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket` at ON ao.parent = at.name
WHERE at.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY ao.item
ORDER BY COUNT(ao.name) DESC
